independent_acceptance_review.scope: Focused independent acceptance of all three existing Problems and their local repairs in arXiv:2312.07363v1. Current root read the entire 324-line report, findings and coverage, source pages 1,2,4,7,9,46-49,58-60, and actually viewed the decisive source pages recorded below. Initial whole-paper/SFT/Gromov-Witten checking is not claimed again.

findings.independent_reason: The source's intrinsic symplectization and alpha-chart definitions permit an arbitrary compatible structure in a compact band. The stated shear is symplectic and yields positive symmetric Omega J, whereas conjugation by D=diag(2,1,1,1) gives the displayed nonsymmetric Omega(D^-1JD). Compact symplectic conjugation realizes the witness without changing adjusted ends. A J-dependent increasing f that is identity on its non-adjusted band and has slope r at both ends preserves compatibility through the adjusted transitions. The holomorphic-curve correspondence and positive-action scaling give the supremum inequality in each direction, including infinite values. The failed fixed-map assertion is used for scaling/continuity and Theorem 5; the repair does not establish all other external analytic inputs.

findings.disposition: retain Major; conditional local replacement verified
findings.independent_reason: At t=1, beta_t is the Zoll form and contains every fiber orbit; for t<1 a noncritical fiber of nonconstant S is not an orbit. The exact C2 difference is (1-t)||S-1||C2, so only t tending to 1 supplies arbitrary C2 closeness for fixed S. On [0,1), the uniform short spectral window and delta<1/3 rule out both long orbits and sums of two short actions. Normalizing by 1-t produces a continuous function into the fixed Sard-null critical-value set, hence a constant; applying Proposition 10.4 near 1 gives the claimed min/max identities. This corrects a core spectral-identification step, without claiming a counterexample to the final geodesic theorem.

findings.disposition: retain Major for the unrestricted sharpness assertions
findings.independent_reason: The source introduction has no global n>=2 restriction and p7 explicitly allows n>=1. For M=S1 all positive contact forms have minimal period and contact volume both equal to their integral, so the ratio is identically one. For a planar smooth star-shaped domain, the action-angle boundary map with g'=2pi b/A is symplectic; its interpolating Hamiltonian can be cut off on a compact annulus containing all boundary trajectories. It therefore gives the required ambient, not merely intrinsic, symplectomorphism to the equal-area disk. Every normalized extrinsic capacity and systole equal area. The n>=2 restriction repairs strict sharpness; it does not remove valid positive coincidence statements in dimension one.
